content.user_title: Analyze Network Traffic and Bandwidth Use
content.value_statement: Network teams need a fast way to understand bandwidth use and application mix. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through DPI, client, and device traffic analysis workflows.
actual_capabilities: List DPI application categories and explain their traffic role.
Identify top clients by bandwidth use when client stats are available.
Correlate device throughput with client demand and application categories.
Produce traffic reports with utilization patterns and optimization suggestions.
Recommend QoS and bandwidth allocation changes from observed traffic data.
limitations: Requires compatible network telemetry tools and current controller data.
Does not capture packets or inspect payload content directly.
Cannot enforce QoS policies without separate network administration tools.
Recommendations depend on the accuracy of DPI classification.

use_cases.title: Find Bandwidth Hotspots
use_cases.description: Identify top clients and application categories before changing traffic policies.

use_cases.title: Plan Capacity Upgrades
use_cases.description: Create concise traffic reports for bandwidth planning and upgrade decisions.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot Slow Networks
use_cases.description: Compare device throughput, client demand, and application categories to isolate congestion causes.

prompt_templates.title: Show Current Traffic Mix
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze current DPI categories and summarize which application types use the most bandwidth.

prompt_templates.title: Find Heavy Bandwidth Users
prompt_templates.prompt: Use client statistics to identify the top bandwidth consumers and explain likely causes.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot Congestion
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare device throughput, client bandwidth, and DPI categories to identify likely congestion sources.

prompt_templates.title: Design QoS Recommendations
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a traffic management plan using DPI categories, top clients, and observed throughput trends.

output_examples.input: What applications are using the most bandwidth?
output: Streaming media is the largest category during the review window.
Business collaboration traffic is the second largest category.
Review QoS rules for streaming traffic during business hours.

output_examples.input: Show top bandwidth-consuming clients and recommend actions.
output_examples.output: The report ranks clients by bandwidth use, highlights unusual consumers, and suggests policy checks for the highest usage devices.

output_examples.input: Identify likely congestion causes from device and client stats.
output_examples.output: The analysis compares throughput, client demand, and DPI categories, then lists the most likely bottlenecks with supporting evidence.

best_practices: Review traffic at consistent times before comparing trends.
Correlate DPI categories with client and device statistics.
Document each QoS recommendation with the traffic evidence used.
anti_patterns: Do not make policy changes from a single short traffic sample.
Do not treat DPI labels as proof of user intent.
Do not ignore device throughput when diagnosing client complaints.

faq.question: Does this skill inspect packet payloads?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on DPI categories, bandwidth statistics, client usage, and device throughput.

faq.question: Can it change QoS settings automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can recommend QoS changes, but policy enforcement requires separate administration tools.

faq.question: Which tools does it expect?
faq.answer: It references DPI category, client statistics, network device, and device statistics tools.

faq.question: Can Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What data quality does it need?
faq.answer: It needs current telemetry with reliable DPI classification and client bandwidth statistics.

faq.question: Is it useful for capacity planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It can summarize traffic patterns and support bandwidth upgrade decisions.
